title: Pictograms / Contribution

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Keep a growing illustration vocabulary coherent by specifying how new symbols are built and reviewed.
strategic_value: A common starter grid and preserved strokes can help IBM extend its pictogram library without losing characteristic line quality.
demonstration: The text-led page groups resource cards, construction criteria, delivery requirements and approval stages.
practical_value: Prepare a 32px Illustrator pictogram with intact strokes and the correct grouping before submission.

content_islands.name: Resource cards
content_islands.spec: Place productive and expressive master files beside starter and library references.

content_islands.name: Design criteria
content_islands.spec: Explain uniqueness, accessibility and understandable metaphors.

content_islands.name: Construction and delivery
content_islands.spec: Specify 1px padding, grid alignment, named layers, Illustrator format and intact strokes.

content_islands.name: Approval process
content_islands.spec: Close with numbered review and publication stages plus request links.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction explains the need for a contribution process as IBM adds products and services.
reference_purposes.Application: The page specifies workspace setup, grouping, naming and delivery.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Production-ready pictograms are 32×32px Illustrator files with strokes kept intact, unlike the expanded-stroke UI-icon requirements.
